notes.title: Patch 2.0.1.3 is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just released a small patch, which mostly fixes a missing variable in the game. 


[b]Patch notes 2.0.1.3[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a couple of typos thanks to a report by community member Seranth
[*] Fixed a missing variable preventing the game from taking into account a player choice in the Aeternus P02 finale
[/list]

We hope you enjoy your time aboard Kappa station.

notes.title: Love Thyself - A Horatio Story Part 2 Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815009/c9fdb6b1ddecf9926d77add5925e2b1cb8f82db4.jpg[/img]

Just over two months ago, we released Love Thyself – A Horatio Story, the first ever visual novel set in the Endless Universe. Some people thought we were just indulging in an elaborate April Fool’s joke, but those who tried the game found a (mostly) serious story about finding your place in a society of clones. Many players have told us that they love this personal look at the Endless universe, and that they are eager for more.

The wait is finally over! [b]Love Thyself – A Horatio Story Part 2[/b], the exciting conclusion to this tale of clones, is out for free on Steam now! If you have already installed Love Thyself, Steam will automatically update the game with the Part 2 content. If you have not, this is a great time to check it out at the low price of absolutely [b]free[/b].


[b][u]Part 2 Features:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Discover [b]new locations[/b] across Kappa Station[/*]
[*]Meet [b]new characters[/b], some of them not even Horatio[/*]
[*][b]Four unique endings[/b] based on your actions and attitude[/*]
[*]Get to know [b]four uniquely identical Horatio[/b], and perhaps more[/*]
[*][b]New achievements[/b], for those among you who pursue perfection[/*]
[/list]



In addition to Part 2, we are releasing a [b]bonus ending[/b] to our amazing Games2Gether community. Uncover the secrets of Kappa station and become the best Horatio you can be in the [b]Super Secret Ending[/b]!

[url=https://www.games2gether.com/profile/me/rewards][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815009/ce8191cc6b4e7be9acd665000871f9c99d62c509.png[/img][/url]

To unlock this bonus content, go to your rewards page, link your Steam Account, and click the “Redeem it on Steam” button in the description of the Love Thyself Super Secret Ending reward. This will add the Super Secret Ending DLC to your Steam library for you to enjoy.



Have fun,

The Amplitude Team
